categories.main_business_segments: China General Nuclear Power Corporation (CGN Power) primarily operates in nuclear power generation, including the construction, operation, and management of nuclear power plants. The company also engages in power sales, nuclear power plant design and research, engineering construction, and related technical services. Additionally, CGN Power explores nuclear energy comprehensive utilization and related clean energy projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on pressurized water reactor (PWR) technology, including second-generation M310, CPR1000, ACPR1000, and third-generation Hualong One (华龙一号) nuclear technologies. It emphasizes continuous technological innovation, safety improvements, and digital transformation in construction and operation. Advanced construction methods such as modular, mechanized, automated, and digitalized techniques are applied, including a nuclear-specific 'building machine' for reactor building construction.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CGN Power's primary customers are regional power grid companies such as China Southern Power Grid and State Grid Corporation subsidiaries, which purchase electricity generated by its nuclear power plants. The company also provides engineering, technical support, and maintenance services to affiliated nuclear enterprises and joint ventures. Its markets are mainly in China, serving provincial and regional electricity demand centers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China, with nuclear power bases in Guangdong (including Daya Bay, Ling Ao, Ling Dong, Yangjiang, Taishan, and Lufeng), Fujian (Ningde), Liaoning (Hongyanhe), Guangxi (Fangchenggang), and Shandong (Zhaoyuan). It also has overseas operations denominated in USD, notably through joint ventures. The company is listed on the Shenzhen and Hong Kong stock exchanges.
categories.supply_chain_position: CGN Power operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the nuclear power supply chain, focusing on nuclear power plant construction, operation, and electricity sales. It also engages in upstream activities such as nuclear fuel procurement and technology development through affiliated entities. The company manages the full lifecycle of nuclear power assets, including design, construction, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning provisions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes nuclear safety, technological innovation, and digital transformation. It invests heavily in R&D platforms, including national engineering centers and key laboratories, focusing on advanced nuclear technologies such as fourth-generation reactors and small modular reactors. CGN Power emphasizes the optimization of Hualong One technology, safety system improvements, and the development of nuclear energy comprehensive utilization solutions, including nuclear heating and energy storage.
categories.revenue_model: CGN Power generates revenue primarily through the sale of electricity produced by its nuclear power plants under long-term contracts with regional grid companies. Additional revenue streams include engineering construction services, technical support and maintenance services, and sales of related products. The company also receives government subsidies and tax incentives related to its clean energy operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CGN Power is one of the leading nuclear power operators in China and globally, managing the largest operational and under-construction nuclear capacity in the country. Its main competitors include China National Nuclear Corporation (CNNC) and State Power Investment Corporation (SPIC). CGN Power positions itself as a world-class nuclear energy supplier and service provider with a strong emphasis on safety, innovation, and operational excellence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, CGN Power reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 86.8 billion, a 5.2% increase over the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 10.8 billion, up 0.8%. The company manages 28 operational nuclear units with a total installed capacity of 31,798 MW and 16 units under construction. It maintains a stable dividend payout policy with a payout ratio around 44%. The company’s total assets exceed RMB 425 billion, with a moderate leverage ratio of 59.5%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CGN Power emphasizes nuclear safety as its core value, adhering to principles of 'safety first, quality first, and pursuit of excellence.' It differentiates itself through advanced nuclear technologies like Hualong One, high operational efficiency with world-leading capacity factors, and comprehensive risk management. The company also highlights its commitment to environmental sustainability, contributing significantly to carbon emission reductions and clean energy supply in China.
